final: WITH c AS (SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS t FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId), s AS (SELECT CustomerId, t, t*1.0/(SELECT SUM(Total) FROM Invoice) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT AVG(s.t) AS avg_total_spent, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG((s.share - a.avg_share)/a.avg_share) AS avg_rel_diff FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
